title: CSWinUNETR: Segmentation of Thin Anatomical Structures in Medical Images
mechanism: Thin-structure backbone with cross-shaped stripe self-attention and cyclic shift for long principal-axis context, detail-enhanced multi-scale attention, and sparse-control dynamic snake convolution.
adaptation: 2D variant, 1-channel input, 512 px, house CE+Dice loss and schedule, trained from scratch on 478 cells. Stripe attention suits busbar-aligned and diagonal cracks and long scuff streaks on E1.
min_experiment: Arm: 2D CSWinUNETR, 20k and 40k steps, 5 seeds. Baseline: house U-Net++ R34. Metrics: test crack IoU, relF1@2, mIoU_rob, gridline IoU, E1 relF1@2. Kill: 2-seed mean crack IoU or mIoU_rob more than 0.02 below house.
evidence: R: FIVES (500 train) Dice 90.71 vs nnUNetv2 89.26; FFHQ-Wrinkle (800 train, thin low-contrast lines) Dice 64.75 vs 63.27; TopCoW 3D clDice gains; 31M params (2D); Dice+CE only, no topology loss; paired t-test with BH correction.
prior_overlap: none. BRIEF section 5 lists transformer segmenters as never tried.
